name: multi-company-portal
description: Multi-company login portal that hosts the FinTrack financial app per tenant, with master/staff accounts.
whatsNew: Fixed the Provider page's "Link companies" checklist under each owner: the checkboxes were stretched and misaligned, and company logos weren't showing. Each row now shows the company's logo (or a placeholder) next to a properly-aligned checkbox and name.

Fixed the Owner overview's mobile layout: the account menu could land near the left edge of the screen, causing its dropdown to open mostly off-screen. It's now pinned to its own row on the right, and the date picker/icons no longer feel cramped together.
The Owner overview can now look at any past date, not just today — pick a date and every company's card updates to show that day's deposits, withdrawals, Win/Loss and Store balance.
